text:
The open-loop current balance keeps failing. The root cause is narrow-width Vth mismatch between the differently-sized replica and main devices. I'm rebuilding M1, M2 and M5, M3, M6 from identical unit devices, so the mirror ratios hold exactly in simulation. I'm also moving the output target toward mid-rail to absorb the remaining offset.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Vout collapse is from width-dependent Vth mismatch (M5/M3 vs M1/M2 Vth differ 20 mV), not the topology. Build all mirror devices from identical unit fingers with integer ratios, M6 also unit-based plus a small trim finger, and centre Vout near 0.8 V for margin."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "N":      (20.0, 16.0, 22.0),      # main/replica unit ratio (rounded)
    "Ln":     (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),         # NMOS L (M1, M5, M6 identical units)
    "Lp":     (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),         # PMOS L (M2, M3 identical units)
    "gmid_p": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),      # PMOS gm/Id -> Vsg -> Vout target
    "t":      (0.3, 0.0, 0.6),         # trim finger on M6 (fraction of a unit)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ln, Lp = p["Ln"], p["Lp"]
    N = int(round(p["N"]))
    m6 = 2
    t = p["t"]
    Iu = iref / (m6 + t)          # current per unit finger
    I1 = N * Iu

    # PMOS unit: gm/Id sets Vsg -> Vout = VDD - Vsg (replica diode drain = same node level)
    vsg = 1.0
    for _ in range(5):
        mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, Iu, vds=vsg)
        vsg = mp.vgs
    Wp = max(mp.W, 0.5)
    vout_t = VDD - vsg

    # NMOS unit: Id(vgs=vin, vds=vout_t) = Iu
    Wn = 2.0
    for _ in range(12):
        Id_t = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout_t)["Id"]
        Wn = Wn * Iu / max(Id_t, 1e-15)
    Wn = min(max(Wn, 0.5), 200)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # reference diode: m6 unit fingers + trim finger (gate ~ vin at Iu per unit)
    for k in range(m6):
        n.M("M6_%d" % k, "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    if t * Wn >= 0.42:
        n.M("M6_t", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", t * Wn, Ln)
    # replica branch: one NMOS unit + one PMOS unit diode
    n.M("M5", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.M("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    # main branch: N identical units each
    for k in range(N):
        n.M("M2_%d" % k, "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
        n.M("M1_%d" % k, "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)

    op1 = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout_t)
    op2 = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg, VDD - vout_t)
    gm = N * op1["gm"]
    gds = N * (op1["gds"] + op2["gds"])
    A = gm / gds
    cpar = 1.0e-15 * 0.8 * N * (Wn + Wp)
    cout = cl + cpar
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    f3 = gds / (2 * PI * cout)
    power = VDD * (iref + Iu + I1)
    swing = VDD - op1["vdsat"] - op2["vdsat"] - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_t, "swing": swing, "inverting": 1}
```
